{{Otheruses|Outrider}}
'''''Outrider Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of four [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]]. They were providing fighter escort for an old [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Rahmat]]'' which was escorting a group of 3 [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] [[Furlo group|''Furlo'']]. The Squadron had already [[Attack on the Zaarin supply convoy|engaged]] with [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] from [[Tau Squadron]], leaving only one left by the time [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] arrived in a [[Missile Boat]]. Stele would engage and destroy both Outrider and [[Inrider Squadron]] that was launched from the Dreadnaught before the ship was also destroyed by Stele.
